description_en: You can invoke UnregisterDevice to delete the device registration record of a specified agent under a specified instance. After deletion, the SIP phone or SIP softphone associated with the agent becomes inactive
description_zh: 调用UnregisterDevice删除指定实例下指定坐席的设备注册记录，删除后将导致与坐席关联的SIP话机或SIP软电话不可用
kebab_example: aliyun ccc unregister-device --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnregisterDevice
